# AppBlocks Web 0.4 - model instructions

AppBlocks Web compiles an indentation DSL into complete HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Output AppBlocks source, not HTML, JSX, CSS or JavaScript.

Choose one authoring mode:
- Canonical mode: use full block and attribute names from the catalog.
- Compact mode: read LLMS-COMPACT.txt and use short aliases, one site recipe and exact virtual component IDs.
- Taste mode: also read LLMS-TASTE.txt; choose one Taste DNA, set the three design dials, plan structural variety, use real assets, and pass the strict Taste audit.

SYNTAX
- Use exactly two spaces per nesting level. Never use tabs.
- A line begins with a lowercase block name or supported compact ID.
- Quoted positional text follows the name: title "Know where every dollar goes"
- Configuration uses key=value: hero variant=split reveal=true
- Values may be quoted strings, bare strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays or simple objects.
- Comments begin with # only outside quotes after whitespace.

CANONICAL MINIMUM
site "Project name" theme=blueprint lang=en base=/
  meta description="Concrete project description"
  header logo="Project name"
    nav
      link "Product" href="/#product"
    button "Primary action" href=/start variant=solid
  footer logo="Project name"
  page "/" title="Specific page title"
    hero variant=split
      eyebrow "Specific context"
      title "Concrete promise" level=1
      text "Useful explanation"
      button "Specific action" href=/start variant=solid

AUTHORING POLICY
1. Choose the largest semantic block that matches the outcome.
2. Put exactly one level=1 title on every page.
3. Give every field a persistent label and every image alt text. Use alt="" only for decorative images.
4. Use links for destinations and buttons for actions.
5. Never emit raw HTML, inline JavaScript or javascript:/data: URLs.
6. Do not fabricate testimonials, metrics, customers, certifications or backend results. Mark demonstration data clearly.
7. Prefer shared header and footer blocks under site.
8. Use page layout=app for application shells that should omit shared marketing chrome.
9. Query contracts instead of guessing: appblocks catalog <name> --json or appblocks-v2 catalog <name> --json.
10. Validate strictly and repair every diagnostic before claiming completion.
11. For Taste work, run appblocks-v2 audit <file> --strict --json and do not ship below 88.
12. Do not draw fake browser, phone, terminal, or dashboard chrome. Use real images, real screenshots, generated assets, or live components.

WORKFLOW
1. Plan routes and the job of each route.
2. Retrieve only relevant contracts.
3. Write one coherent source file.
4. Run strict validation.
5. Build and inspect desktop and mobile output. Taste routes must be inspected at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024, 1280, and 1440 CSS pixels.
6. Connect real backend operations through reviewed adapters; do not simulate production integrations.
